content_sections.heading: About FDDI Ankleshwar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Footwear Design & Development Institute works under the aegis of the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, and describes itself as an Institution of National Importance under the FDDI Act 2017. These posts are being filled on an ad-hoc basis to meet urgent academic requirements at the Ankleshwar campus in Gujarat.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 3 posts in total, one in each row of its vacancy table. The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease at the sole discretion of the management depending upon requirement at the time of recruitment. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts. Candidates from SC/ST/OBC/EWS and differently abled categories can apply.

rows.school: School of Footwear Design and Development

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice states that the qualification and experience of Junior Faculty and Academic Support Cadre shall apply as per the Recruitment Rules for the engagement against the respective positions. Merit, practical teaching ability, presentation and communication skills shall be given due importance. The post-wise requirements printed in the vacancy table are: Desirable for Junior Faculty (New Product Development): knowledge of manual design and operating 2D and 3D Shoe Design software. The same upper age limit is printed for all three posts. The notice does not print a date on which age is counted. For the full eligibility of each post in its discipline, candidates should check the official notification and the Recruitment Rules it refers to.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Initial tenure of engagement is up to 6 months. The engagement may be extended, if required, for further periods of up to 06 months, subject to institutional requirements and approval of the competent authority. Periodic reviews by the Campus ED and Head of Department (based on student feedback, class observation and compliance with duties) form part of the record at the time of re-engagement. For engagement for part of a month, pro-rata payment presuming a 30-day month will be considered. Persons under ad-hoc engagement are eligible for 2 casual leave per month, with carry-forward within the current engagement period of 6 months; unavailed casual leave lapses. No earned leave or leave encashment is admissible. No other benefits are admissible: no claim for HRA, House Allocation, LTC, Medical etc. Temporary house/hostel accommodation can be provided at the discretion of the institute upon payment of due charges, and must be vacated within 15 days of discontinuation of the ad-hoc engagement. FDDI attendance rules and travel on official duty entitlements apply for the respective levels. Working days shall typically be 5 days per week; the engaged person can be required to attend office on weekends or holidays for operational reasons, against which comp-off can be claimed as per the norms of the institution. Ensure maximum student attendance in assigned classes. Ensure discipline in class and encourage students to follow discipline in their conduct. Submit weekly attendance reports through ERP. Participate in departmental reviews and discipline meetings.

content_sections.heading: FDDI Ankleshwar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The following duties and responsibilities are printed for all the posts: Perform all such functions as are the responsibility of the concerned role. Assist in student evaluation, project assessment, and other academic functions as assigned. Discharge such other responsibilities as are assigned by HOD/ED concerned. Adhere to all policies and rules of FDDI as issued from time to time. Candidate must be proficient in fashion design and pattern-making for garments/apparel, with expertise in different styles and categories. Ability to demonstrate practical skills required. Practically sound in machine operation, Garment/Apparel pattern making, sample making and demonstration to students. Must be responsible for the documentation, record keeping and upkeep of the department. Candidate must be well conversant in designing and pattern engineering of various categories of footwear (Classic/Sports/Industrial/Safety/Orthopaedic).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in FDDI Ankleshwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 tentative posts: Junior Faculty (Illustration & CAD), Lab Assistant (Pattern Making & Garment Construction) and Junior Faculty (New Product Development), one each.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for FDDI Ankleshwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for FDDI Junior Faculty (Illustration & CAD)?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree (of min. 02 years' duration after Graduation) in Fashion Design, Graphic Design, Communication Design, Apparel Design, Knitwear Design, Leather Design, Textile Design or Fashion Technology with min. 55% marks, plus at least 3 years of industry/academic experience in Illustration and CAD.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the FDDI Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Lab Assistant (Pattern Making & Garment Construction) post requires Essential 12th Pass, Desirable 10th Pass, and the ability to operate/sew garments and repair lock stich, overlock and flatlock sewing machines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for FDDI Ankleshwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all posts is 35 years for Gen, 38 years for OBC, 40 years for SC/ST and 45 years for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of FDDI Junior Faculty and Lab Assistant?
faq.answer: Junior Faculty get Rs. 50,000/- per month and Academic Support Cadre staff (e.g., Lab assistant) get Rs. 30,000/- per month as consolidated pay.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for FDDI Ankleshwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application format with a CV and self-attested documents by registered post/courier to The Executive Director, FDDI, H-3301 NEAR ESIC HOSPITAL, GIDC, Ankleshwar, Gujarat 393002, with the post written on the envelope, or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for FDDI Ankleshwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through interview, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for it.

faq.question: Q9. Is the FDDI Ankleshwar job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on an ad-hoc basis with an initial tenure of up to 6 months, which may be extended for further periods of up to 06 months subject to institutional requirements and approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q10. Do FDDI ad-hoc staff get HRA or other allowances?
faq.answer: No, there is no claim for HRA, House Allocation, LTC, Medical etc.; staff get 2 casual leave per month, and temporary house/hostel accommodation may be provided at the institute's discretion on payment of due charges.
